relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.evidence: With David Jongeward he published a catalogue of Kushan, Kushano-Sasanian and Kidarite Hun coins in the American Numismatic Society New York in 2015.

relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.evidence: In 2021, he was appointed Adjunct Professor of Numismatics at Hebei Normal University, China.

relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.object: Queen Mary College, University of London
relations.evidence: Joe Cribb studied Latin, Greek, and Ancient History at Queen Mary College, University of London, graduating in 1970.

relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.evidence: He became a research assistant at the Department of Coins and Medals at the British Museum.

relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.role: Keeper of the Coins and Medals
relations.evidence: He eventually rose to be the Keeper of the Coins and Medals (2003–2010), before his retirement in 2010.

relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.evidence: Cribb was President of the Royal Numismatic Society (2005–2009)

relations.subject: Joe Cribb
relations.evidence: and was Secretary General of the Oriental Numismatic Society (2011–2018).
